name: Sofia
bio: Handmade pasta, a glass of red, and a table where you can hear each other.
dateIdea: Sharing a bowl of fresh pasta, then lingering over an espresso.
askMeAbout: The one dish I always try to recreate at home.

name: Theo
bio: Always orders something to share. Tiramisu is never up for debate.
dateIdea: Splitting three starters instead of two mains.
askMeAbout: My ranking of every tiramisu in the city.

name: Amara
bio: Sunday pasta projects and tiny Italian spots. Ask me about my ragù.
dateIdea: A glass of wine somewhere quiet, then deciding on dinner together.
askMeAbout: How long a proper ragù should simmer.

name: Leo
bio: Here for fresh gnocchi, good conversation, and one more espresso.
dateIdea: Wine bar first, late-night gelato after.
askMeAbout: The best espresso I've had outside Italy.

name: Kenji
bio: Counter seats, chef's choice, and no phones on the table.
dateIdea: Omakase at the counter, letting the chef decide.
askMeAbout: Why the best sushi is the simplest.

name: Mara
bio: Food writer. Firm believer that the best dates start with a great meal.
dateIdea: Trying something on the menu neither of us can pronounce.
askMeAbout: The worst restaurant review I ever wrote.

name: Hana
bio: Yakitori, cold sake, and laughing too loud at the bar.
dateIdea: Ordering one of everything on the skewer menu.

name: Diego
bio: Will drive across town for the right al pastor.
dateIdea: Tacos on a patio, then a walk through the Mission murals.

name: Lucia
bio: Mezcal over margaritas. Always up for a new taqueria.
dateIdea: A mezcal tasting where we both pretend to know what we're doing.
askMeAbout: The difference between mezcal and tequila.

name: Sam
bio: Spice tolerance: high. Patience for bland food: low.
dateIdea: Whoever orders the spiciest dish picks dessert.
askMeAbout: The hottest thing I've ever eaten.

name: Priya
bio: Loves Thai and Indian food. Prefers relaxed evenings over loud venues.
dateIdea: Sharing a thali and comparing favourite dishes.
askMeAbout: The best chai in the city.

name: Arjun
dateIdea: Street food crawl, one plate at each stop.
askMeAbout: How to fold a perfect dosa.

name: Nadia
bio: Chaat enthusiast. Will share, but only if you share back.
dateIdea: Too many small plates and a mango lassi each.

name: Mali
bio: Khao soi on cold nights, papaya salad on warm ones.
dateIdea: A cozy noodle shop and a long chat.
askMeAbout: The Thai dish everyone should try once.

name: Jonah
bio: Noodles in any form. Ramen, pad see ew, you name it.
dateIdea: Cocktails with a view, then late-night noodles.
askMeAbout: My noodle map of San Francisco.

name: Omar
bio: Low-key first dates and bold flavours.
dateIdea: One good cocktail and a long conversation.
